[Section] Conclusion
[source_id=59] We has built the first Japanese INLINEFORM0 Vietnamese NMT systems and released the dataset as well as the associated training scripts. We have also shown that the proposed VNBPE algorithm can be used for Vietnamese word segmentation in order to conduct neural machine translation. Furthermore, by adapting Back Translation and Mix-Source, our NMT systems achieved the best improvement on the dataset. In the future, we will exploit more domain and multilingual information to improve the quality of the systems.
